newsitem.title: USA: NYC Water Authority to sell $400 mln of bonds.
newsitem.headline: NYC Water Authority to sell $400 mln of bonds.

text.p: New York City Municipal Finance Water Authority on Friday said it planned to sell by negotiation in mid-October about $400 million of revenue bonds, a city official said.
The authority also is considering whether to include a refunding in the debt offering, which is expected during the week of October 14, but likely will hold off a bit longer on making its decision.
"We really wait until the last minute," the city official said, explaining the authority hopes to capture the most favorable market conditions that it can.

The $400 million of bonds that will be sold will raise new money, the city official said, adding that the debt will be sold under the authority's "first resolution," which means it is senior to debt sold under a second type of authorization.
The authority hopes to soon select which of the three members of its underwriting team will lead the sale. They are J.P. Morgan & Co, Goldman, Sachs & Co, and PaineWebber Group Inc.
